tactics: Before a first call, find one public sign of change at the account, such as a new hire, a raise or a launch. Open with that, not your product.
Ask AI to turn a prospect’s last three posts or earnings calls into three likely pains. Lead with the one you can actually solve.
Let AI draft, never send. Rewrite the first line yourself so it sounds like you.
Give every opportunity a clear “why now”. No why now, no forecast.
Send the recap within 10 minutes of the call. Have AI turn your notes into the email; speed beats polish.
Score last quarter’s wins against your ideal customer profile. Prospect only where three or more traits match.
Multi-thread early: have a second named contact in every deal by the second meeting.
tips: Pick partners by who already owns the customer relationship, not by logo size.
Land one co-sold deal with a new partner within 90 days. Momentum beats enablement decks.
Make deal registration take under five minutes. If it’s slow, partners stop registering.
Track partner-sourced pipeline, not just partner-influenced. It keeps the programme honest.
